title: Antique Bronze Towel Bar 18-Inch Wall-Mounted Powder-Coated Iron, Pipeline Industrial Pipe Style, Allied Brass
description:
Stop draping towels over doors and countertops with this wall-mounted towel bar—also called a towel rack or towel holder—built for an authentic industrial bathroom hardware look in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability.

Highlights:
- Antique Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Count on dependable everyday performance with iron construction and a highly durable powder coat
- Maintain a clean, decorative finish designed for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
- Mounts firmly to the wall with included mounting plates and color-coordinated screws (wall hanging installation)

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Towel bar / towel rack / towel holder / towel rail
- Collection: Pipeline
- Style: Industrial; pipe-style accessories for loft bathroom fixtures
- Material: Iron (brass construction not applicable)
- Mounting type: Wall mount / wall-mounted
- Center-to-center: 18 in
- Bar diameter: 0.75 in
- Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 3 x 3.3 in; projection: 3.3 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Included items: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
